description: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct AWQ 4-bit with steering vectors re-derived on quantized activations. Same layer/schedule as FP16 14B (L17 creative, L24 technical). Validation target: creativity/logic scores within 2 points of FP16 baseline.

layers.note: Same layers as FP16 14B. Vectors re-derived on AWQ-quantized model to match the quantized activation geometry.

quantization.note: Quantized from Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. Steering vectors MUST be re-derived on quantized model — FP16 vectors will produce degraded output.

runtime_defaults.iterative_anti_mode_notes: Same as FP16: captures first generated token's L17 residual per sample and orthogonalizes the creative vector against the mean prior residual.

known_caveats: Steering vectors must be extracted from the AWQ model, not the FP16 model.
AWQ 4-bit may slightly reduce tail creativity (rare/unusual idea paths); validate with eval harness.
Alpha schedule inherited from FP16 sweep — may benefit from re-sweep on quantized model.
